name: Launch
tagline: Complete 35-page Launch display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.
occasion: software launches and product demonstrations with independent device/screenshot frames

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: DM Sans display with DM Sans body; original source font-family roles, declared weights, sizes and frames retained. Original unmodified font files are embedded with their own licenses; font versions are recorded. No common font substitution.

best_for: Software launches and product demonstrations with independent device/screenshot frames, feature mosaics, supporting metrics and pricing.
avoid_for: Dense legal documents, long-form classroom handouts, or product stories without a visual demonstration.
